info.name: Veeam Backup for AWS public API 1.0 Agents Backup Objects API

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of backup objects to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of backup objects to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts backup objects by one of the backup object parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts backup objects in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters backup objects by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any backup object parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning and/or at the end.

params.name: platformNameFilter
params.description: Filters backup objects by platform ID.

params.name: platformIdFilter
params.description: Filters backup objects by platform ID.

params.name: typeFilter
params.description: Filters backup objects by object type.

params.name: viTypeFilter
params.description: Filters backup objects by the type of VMware vSphere server.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backupObjects` path allows you to get an array of virtual infrastructure objects (VMs and VM containers) that are included in backups created by the backup server.
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backupObjects/{id}` path allows you to get a backup object that has the specified `id`.
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backupObjects/{id}/restorePoints` path allows you to get an array of restore points of a backup object that has the specified `id`.
